title: The Origin of Nations After the Great Flood
description: After the Great Flood, Noah's three sons—Shem, Ham, and Japheth—spread out over the earth, and their descendants became the origin of nations, including Nimrod, who founded Babel and Nineveh.

versions.title: The Origin of Nations After the Flood
versions.description: After the Flood, Noah's three sons—Shem, Ham, and Japheth—spread out over the earth, and their descendants became the origin of all the world's nations.
